getStatsDistribution(stats_distribution_property: StrengthStatsDistributionProperty) → StatsDistribution#

Returns a StatsDistribution for a joint strength parameter. Probabilistic analysis must be enabled first.

The stats_distribution_property argument selects which strength input to edit, for example StrengthStatsDistributionProperty.Cohesion, StrengthStatsDistributionProperty.Phi, or StrengthStatsDistributionProperty.Jrc (see StrengthStatsDistributionProperty for the full list).
